programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana Martyna and her team circled the Earth once again.She reached places she had never been before.She visited, among others:Bhutan - a mysterious kingdom in the Himalayas, where the happiest people in the world live, and in Papua she lived in one village with the Dani population.When traveling long distances, the simplest activities turn out to be a challenge.Viewers will learn how to wash their hair when the temperature does not exceed 10 degrees and how to attach a microphone when the interlocutor's only clothing is a gourd.The traveler will check how the heroines of her previous expeditions are doing.He will also reveal the secrets of creating such a unique program.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna goes to Saint Petersburg, where she will meet Larisa Renar, who runs the Academy of Private Life.Women can find answers to all their questions about women's and men's issues there.Over 150,000 students have already completed courses conducted by Larisa - not only from Russia, but also from China, England, the United Arab Emirates, Bulgaria and Turkey.The heroine of the episode completed her MBA;is a psychologist, motivational trainer, and author of eight guides for women.For Russian women, whose salary is 1/3 less than men's, marriage has not only a romantic aspect, but also a business one.Hence the popularity of Larissa Academy.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Malaysia.There he meets with members of the Badjao community, which the rest of the world has not yet heard of.According to legends, their ancestors had gills.Currently, these people can stay underwater for several minutes on one breath and dive to a depth of 20-30 meters without any specialized equipment.The Badjao live on boats or in houses built on stilts.They spend their whole lives there, so when they come ashore, they get land sickness.Their children learn to swim before they can even walk.The traveler visits a local healer, Djirajniha, who enjoys great trust and respect.Thanks to it, Martyna Wojciechowska can get to know the extraordinary world of Badjao.

programme.title: Operation: FLIGHT
programme.desc: Documentarians present the behind-the-scenes work of Warsaw's Chopin Airport and LOT Polish Airlines.Together with the cameras, they will reach places where until now only staff members had access.The airport is a place where you cannot afford to make mistakes.Extraordinary safety requirements make each process equally important and extremely interesting.Viewers can finally see, among others:who supervises air traffic and how, what happens to luggage left before check-in, and how flight attendants prepare for each flight.Everything related to the operation of an airport requires perfect operation and planning.PLL LOT transports almost five million passengers annually.

programme.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who breathed new life into very old buildings.When Violetta stumbled upon her future home, it was just a shanty.Despite this, she fell in love with it and began the difficult renovation.Afterwards, she could live in her dream house with blue shutters.Sławek was looking for his place on earth for a long time.He finally realized that it would be best for him to stay in his grandmother's old house.Restored after over 50 years, the building is full of memorabilia from the late owner.Milena and Patrick decided to purchase a 19th-century manor and palace complex.The renovation has been going on there for 13 years, but it is already clear that its effects are stunning.

programme.title: Unobvious places
programme.desc: This time Katarzyna Jaroszyńska will visit people whose houses are distinguished by style.Kasia and her husband bought a plot of land in the Bieszczady Mountains and decided to live there as close to nature as possible.The small house belonging to the farm of Jakub and his wife brings to mind American series about prairie inhabitants.Natural elements intertwine with boho accents, and the veranda invites you to spend evenings there with a cup of hot tea.Anna and Krzysztof love Provence.They decorated their caravan on the Baltic Sea in a style reminiscent of this region of France, and now they have managed to create another place smelling of lavender.

programme.title: It's beautiful here
programme.desc: Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original buildings, reveal interior design ideas to viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Three young women vacationing in Paris, find themselves whisked away to Monte Carlo after one of them is mistaken for a British heiress.

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's husband is arrested for murdering nine villagers in El Salvador in 1988, as a US soldier under a different name. She decides to defend him in military court and find out the truth about what happened.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: A young black woman discovers that her father was a sperm donor, and if that weren't bad enough, he's white!

programme.title: Minotaur
programme.desc: When the villagers offer their brethren as a sacrifice to the Minotaur, Theo (Tom Hardy) sets off on a harrowing quest to the labyrinth to kill the evil bull-god.

programme.title: Desolation
programme.desc: A mom, her son, and her best friend go on a journey deep into the wilderness to spread the father's ashes. They find themselves facing their fears when a solitary hiker starts trailing them.

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: After Lily rejects her boyfriend's marriage proposal, she returns home to Hawaii where she must help out with her mother's wedding planning business.

programme.title: Captain Sharky
programme.desc: Pint-sized swashbuckler Captain Sharky thinks he's the most dangerous pirate on the Seven Seas. To prove his bravery, he sets sail with Mikey, a well-behaved boy whose life Sharky has turned upside down, and Bonnie, a trouble-shooting girl who tends to assume command in every situation. This motley crew sails for big adventures as they thwart the plans of The Admiral and Old Bill the Pirate.

programme.title: A Costume for Nicolas
programme.desc: Nicolás goes to live with Mia and Tomás, his loving grandparents, and his cousin David, who suffers from scary nightmares. Nicolás helps David overcome his fears with his vivid imagination, his sense of adventure and….. his trunk of fantastic costumes.

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: Maya is a determined little bee, but sometimes her determination can get her into sticky situations. When Maya accidentally embarrasses the Empress of Buzztropolis, she is forced to venture beyond her colony and team up with a group of mis-fit bugs in a bid to win The Honey Games and save her life.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programme.title: Eagle's Wing
programme.desc: A white trapper steals a white mustang called "Eagle Wing" from a Kiowa Indian, who pursues him to get his horse back

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: ER doc Jessica loves her job, but not the hours. Meeting Trevor in Fiji, Jessica also strikes up a friendship with Will, co-owner of their resort. As Jessica notices how Trevor is a workaholic, she also sees that Will offers tranquility.

programme.title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
programme.desc: After a freak accident, a company executive turns completely invisible, goes on the run, and becomes hunted by a treacherous CIA official while trying to cope with his new reality.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: A celebrated military contractor returns to the site of his greatest career triumphs and reconnects with a long-ago love, while unexpectedly falling for the hard-charging Air Force watchdog assigned to him.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom.

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: In 1990s Pittsburgh, a medicine peddler starts a relationship with a young woman suffering from Parkinson's disease.

programme.title: Finder's Fee
programme.desc: A man finds a wallet containing a winning lottery ticket worth $6 million.
